objective.business: Introduce a fictional premium volumizing shampoo and create a reusable launch asset system.
objective.communication: Make natural-looking, mobile volume feel visibly different from stiff or over-styled volume.

audience.primary: Urban professionals who value polished self-care but reject routines that look effortful.
audience.context: They encounter the asset in a fast vertical feed and decide within seconds whether the product feels premium and relevant.
audience.current_belief: Volumizing products often trade softness and movement for a rigid styled look.

tension.statement: The audience wants visible control while preserving the appearance of ease.

insight.statement: For this audience, the most premium effort is effort that disappears from view.

support.claim: The fictional product is positioned around light, touchable volume rather than rigid hold.

proposition: Visible lift that still moves like you.

desired_response.think: This is volume without the visibly styled stiffness I avoid.
desired_response.do: Watch the product demonstration and explore the launch offer.

must: preserve fictional bottle geometry and label
keep the world restrained and contemporary
must_not: copy a real campaign or identifiable celebrity

references.role: product geometry, label, cap, and liquid color
warm directional light and shadow softness only
hair movement rhythm and camera acceleration only

assumptions: Audience tension and insight are working hypotheses until research or test evidence is supplied.
